subject: Private local household snapshot staging and exact backup
reviewRepairs: Removed capture-derived status-count defaults; all source membership statuses are accepted.
Reject duplicate source account IDs and duplicate store records before Map construction.
Reject unsupported top-level store collections that runtime save would discard.
Reject source reuse of the old robot identity as a human account.
Preserve shared profiles in unrelated loops and reject conflicting imported values.
Replace only pristine bootstrap membership or allow a serialized no-op import; refuse loss of existing household state.
New profile-only human accounts use the original inactive default; existing account activation and signing keys are retained.
Use complete file writes, exclusive mode0600 output and backup, fsync, and file-identity guards during failed-write cleanup.

verification.injectedRaces: Competing exclusive output and replacement during failed backup are retained.
verification.privacy: No captured personal values in added source, tests or documentation; private statistics and source snapshots are not published.

limits: Stages private files only; does not capture robot data or replace a running store.
Existing household changes and conflicting identities require explicit migration resolution.
KB snapshots cannot reconstruct missing human credentials or a complete cloud Account database.
The deployed robot migration used the earlier independent private controller; this utility was tested without changing the robot or live backend.
